title: Hi all! I'm an Indie game/game enthusiast English teacher and I published my first game!
author: EkinGames
selftext:
Hey everyone, I just pushed my first playable browser game, **KIYI - Water Hunter**, live on [itch.io](http://itch.io) and wanted to share how the AI workflow actually played out for me.

For a while, I was stuck in the classic solo dev trap trying to build a massive 3D Unity project that was way too big for one person. Eventually, I put that project on hold and decided to focus on something I could actually finish: a 2D underwater metal-detecting, diving extraction, and artifact restoration game built purely in HTML5 and JavaScript so anyone can just click and play in their browser.

I leaned heavily on AI-assisted coding (mainly ChatGPT/Codex workflows) to get the core loops up and running fast. Honestly, the biggest surprise was how far I could get with just prompts. When I first started my Unity project, I didn't know coding at all, yet I ended up with thousands of lines of `.cs` files—and now AI has gotten to a point where it can build whole systems at once. I know a lot of people just throw a few prompts at an AI and publish whatever comes out, but I didn't want to do that. I really pushed it to build the exact game I had in my imagination so I could actually play it myself.

That said, the game I had in mind was a cozy experience driven by curiosity. I wanted a game where you sail out on a modest boat, dive down, and discover interesting things. What keeps you playing is that simple curiosity about what's hidden underneath the water. My old Unity project was actually a cleaning simulator focused on that satisfying ASMR feeling of cleaning things, so I wanted to carry that vibe over into this little cozy game—not just cleaning, but repairing and restoring artifacts too!

It's completely free to play in the browser right now (no downloads). If you're curious about what's underneath the water too, I'd love some honest feedback on the pacing and balance—and I'm happy to answer any questions about the workflow or the headaches I ran into.

Play it here: [https://ekingames.itch.io/kiyi-water-hunter](https://ekingames.itch.io/kiyi-water-hunter)
